decisions.reason: As a small complementary innovation to the firm’s established track system, the adapter likely clears a modest aspiration level and uses little slack, so management would retain it.
A single LED luminaire with only limited visibility after launch likely fell short of the premium brand’s aspiration level relative to comparable firms, so resources would be reallocated.
The home automation server box appears more support- and update-intensive than the lighting core and, with weak evidence of continued prominence, would be dropped after underperforming aspirations.
A luminaire family that received its own product page fits the core portfolio well, and in a growing market management would keep it while results remain acceptable.
An LED luminaire family is close to the firm’s core offer and consistent with its premium sustainable-lighting strategy, so slack and strategic fit favor retention despite sparse evidence.
The LED spotlight series is an incremental extension of the established range, and absent clear failure signals management would keep such a closely related product in a growing industry.
